question: Where was India's first Vande Bharat sleeper train unveiled in September 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ICF, Chennai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Integral Coach Factory (ICF), Chennai**, is one of the leading production units of the Indian Railways, known for manufacturing a variety of rail coaches, including modern and state-of-the-art trains.
 
• In **September 2024**, the **first Vande Bharat sleeper train** was unveiled at the ICF in Chennai, marking a significant milestone in the modernization of Indian Railways.
 
• The Vande Bharat sleeper train is an extension of the highly successful **Vande Bharat Express**, which is a semi-high-speed train known for its comfort, speed, and advanced features.
 
• This sleeper variant has been developed to cater to long-distance travelers, ensuring comfort and convenience during overnight journeys.
 
• The **ICF, Chennai**, has been instrumental in developing these advanced trains with a focus on promoting **‘Make in India’** and enhancing passenger experience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Integral Coach Factory (ICF), Chennai:**

 
 
• Established in **1955**, the ICF is one of the oldest coach manufacturing units of the Indian Railways.
 
• It has been the hub for designing and manufacturing various types of coaches, including **metro coaches, luxury coaches, and high-speed trains**.
 
• The ICF has consistently contributed to the Indian Railways’ goal of modernizing train travel in the country.
 
 
 
• **Vande Bharat Trains:**
 
 
• Also known as **Train 18**, Vande Bharat is India’s first indigenously designed and manufactured semi-high-speed train.
 
• It is equipped with **modern amenities** like onboard Wi-Fi, GPS-based passenger information systems, bio-vacuum toilets, and automatic doors.
 
• The sleeper variant extends the scope of Vande Bharat trains to overnight journeys, combining high-speed travel with comfort for long-distance routes.
 
 
 
• **Other Locations Mentioned in the Options:**
 
 
• **BEML Complex, Bengaluru:** Known for manufacturing metro cars, defense equipment, and heavy earth-moving machinery, but not for passenger trains.
 
• **Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala:** Another key coach manufacturing unit of Indian Railways, but it has not been involved in unveiling the Vande Bharat sleeper train.
 
• **Metro Rail Depot, Mumbai:** Primarily focuses on metro rail operations and maintenance, not related to the manufacturing or unveiling of Indian Railways’ trains.
 
 
 
• **‘Make in India’ Initiative:**
 
 
• The Vande Bharat trains are a part of the **‘Make in India’ campaign**, aimed at boosting indigenous manufacturing capabilities.
 
• ICF, Chennai, has played a pivotal role in achieving this vision by producing high-quality coaches domestically.
